english:
Wednesday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 6 [gdz]: "Who in everything" (Or yamenayni).
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 37 [38]: "Do not forsake."
Book of Exodus 4:1: "And Moses answered... to verse 21: ...before Pharaoh."
Prophet Joel 2:21: "Fear not, O land... to verse 21: ...in Zion."

Thursday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [gdz]: "Truly."
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 70 [71]: "Do not cast [me] off."
Prophet Isaiah 53:1: "Lord, who has believed... to 54:5: ...shall be called."
Epistle of 1 Corinthians 15:1: "Now I would remind you... to verse 28: ...all in all."

Friday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 6 [gdz]: "Lord our God who established."
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 118 [119]: "Let [my cry] come near."
Book of Deuteronomy 10:1: "At that time... to verse 15: ...as of this day."
Book of Job 19:1: "How long... to verse 29: ...their matter."
Prophet Isaiah 45:1: "Thus says the Lord... to verse 13: ...says the Lord of hosts."

Saturday: Feast of Saint Gregory our Enlightener's awesome sufferings and entry into the pit. But in the evening perform a Pre-feast [Nakhatonak]: "Today rejoiced" (Aysor zvartchatsyal), with its proper canons. And in whichever chapel you shall offer the Liturgy, open only that chapel; but after the Liturgy, close it again.
And at night, Tone 7 [gk]: "Today rejoiced." King Forever: "Today the hosts of angels."
Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [dk]: "Who from the Father," with its proper canons.
Magnificat [Metsatsustse]: "Of the patriarch Abraham."
At Midday Liturgy, Introit: "Today rejoices and is glad."
Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 3 [gl]: "All mountains."
Psalm 87 [88]: "They laid me."
Book of Proverbs 1:15: "For righteousness... to 2:22: ...of the blameless."
Prophet Micah 7:7: "But as for me, I will look to the Lord... to verse 10: ...they shall see him."
Epistle of Philippians 1:12: "I want you to know... to verse 21: ...and to die is gain."
Alleluia: "You are a priest forever."
Gospel of Matthew 16:21: "From that time Jesus... to verse 28: ...in his kingdom."
In the Evening, Hymn at the Lamp-lighting [Hambartsi] Tone 3: "Who the mystery."

Sixth Sunday of Great Lent: Tone 2 [b]: "Who the mystery," with its proper canons.
Psalm 112 [113]: "Blessed be the name."
Gospel of Luke 21:5: "And as some spoke... to verse 38: ...to hear him."
Midday Liturgy Psalm Antiphon [Ktsurd]: "Praise is due to you."
Prophet Isaiah 66:1: "Thus says the Lord: Heaven... to verse 24: ...all flesh."
Messedi Psalm 75 [76]: "Make vows."
Epistle of Colossians 2:8: "See to it... to 3:17: ...and the Father through him."
Alleluia: "Make a joyful noise."
Gospel of Matthew 22:34: "But when the Pharisees... to 23:39: ...in the name of the Lord."

Monday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [dk]: "God of our fathers."
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 50 [51]: "Of him who turns."
Prophet Daniel 7:2: "I, Daniel... to verse 27: ...shall obey."
Epistle of 1 Corinthians 12:1: "Now concerning... to verse 7: ...for common good."

Tuesday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 7 [de]: "Of our fathers."
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 127 [128]: "Blessed is everyone."
Epistle of 1 Corinthians 12:8: "To one is given through the Spirit... to verse 27: ...before him."

Wednesday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [dk]: "Blessed are you, Lord God."
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 37 [38]: "Do not forsake me."
Book of Exodus 4:21: "And the Lord said to Moses... to 5:3: ...or with the sword."
Prophet Zechariah 9:9: "Rejoice greatly... to verse 16: ...in his land."
Psalm 85 [86]: "Patient/Slow to anger" (entire).

Thursday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [dk]: "Blessed are you, Lord."
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 70 [71]: "Do not cast me off."
Prophet Ezekiel 37:1: "And the hand of the Lord was upon me... to verse 14: ...says the Lord, Lord."
Epistle of 1 Timothy 3:14: "I hope to write... to verse 15: ...taken up in glory."

Friday: Patristic Hymn [Harts] Tone 7 [gk] (of the penitential canon): "Blessed are you, Lord God."
Midday Liturgy Messedi: Psalm 118 [119]: "Let my cry come near."
Book of Deuteronomy 11:10: "For the land... to verse 25: ...as the Lord spoke to you."
Book of Job 21:1: "Hear... to verse 21: ...to cease is nothing."
Prophet Isaiah 46:3: "Hearken to me... to 47:4: ...the Holy One of Israel."
Psalm 87 [88]: "Let my prayer enter" (entire).

Saturday: Commemoration of the Raising of Lazarus. Today, cease saying the Hymn of Rest at the Gospel service; and after...
